desc:
Both players will be given a drawing and must find the perfect spot and hide themselves! 👀

🔎 Search for your opponent while staying hidden!
🏆 The first player to spot their opponent wins the round!

Earn money from matches to unlock cosmetics and more!

⚠️ Exploiting or inappropriate behavior is not tolerated and may result in a permanent ban.

Can you outsmart your opponent, find the best hiding spot, and spot them before they spot you?

❤️ Enjoying Hide in Drawings? Leave a 👍 and ⭐ to support future updates!
